projectDescription: TradeHunter is a deal-intelligence platform that helps commercial real estate agents and resellers identify undervalued properties and auction inventory — complete with ROI analysis, tax incentive discovery, and automated daily reporting to Google Sheets.
keyFeatures: Automated discovery of undervalued commercial properties across CoStar, CREN, and major realty platforms
ROI potential scoring for commercial parcels and land
Tax incentive and grant lookup per property (Opportunity Zones, historic credits, etc.)
Highway-visibility land search filtered by area code and proximity to major roads
Multi-source auction aggregation: Facebook Marketplace, GovPlanet, government surplus, university surplus, estate sales, foreclosures, tax liens, bankruptcy auctions
Vintage/specialty fitness equipment deal finder (Nautilus, MedX, Body Masters, Nebula, Atlantis, etc.)
Daily automated deal reports exported to Google Sheets
Below-market value scoring and ROI estimates for resale inventory
publicApiSurface: Property Search — filter by market area, property type, price vs. fair market value
ROI Calculator — input purchase price, expected rents/cap rate, return projected net yield
Tax Incentive Lookup — returns applicable federal/state programs for a given parcel
Auction Deal Feed — aggregated listings scored below market value from 20+ platforms
Google Sheets Sync — daily push of new deals matching saved search criteria
Equipment Category Filter — narrow auction results to specific vintage fitness brands
